Trains community health workers in Uganda to run participatory learning and action groups that reduce maternal and newborn deaths. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from January 2024, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="opal-health-aim">25</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Opal Health: participatory learning and action groups for maternal and newborn health (Ambitious Impact, 2024 idea report)](/opal-health) | AIM | January 2024 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="opal-health-aim">25</span> | 596 |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Opal Health existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Opal Health runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://opalhealthafrica.org)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
